title: Organic chemistry I
purpose: Use structure, bonding and nomenclature, organic acids and bases, conformations and stereochemistry, mechanisms with curved arrows, substitution and elimination, alkenes, alkynes, alcohols, ethers, IR spectroscopy and mass spectrometry.

weeks.3: Acids and bases in organic chemistry

blocks.deliverable: Name and draw twenty molecules, including three drugs.
Rank acidity with pKa values and draw chair conformations.
Assign R and S and explain why enantiomers can act differently as drugs.
Week 7 midterm; predict substitution versus elimination.
Identify functional groups from supplied IR and mass spectra.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Mechanism portfolio: draw and explain ten mechanisms with stereochemistry, and identify two unknowns from supplied IR and mass spectra.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
